title: Causal group-masked pretraining for a recurrent teacher

data.fitting_membership: manifest fit train plus fit valid component membership only
data.evaluation_membership: manifest evaluation valid components; used only after fixed checkpoint export
data.labels_and_score_masks: omitted by SequenceFile.read(targets=false, mask=false) in pretraining and statistics

masking.mask_rule: uniformly choose one group per 32-row block and sequence; hide every value of that group in the block
masking.mask_indicator: append 112 binary channels after the 211 canonical inputs
masking.masked_value: replace raw value with fitting-only feature mean
masking.event_rebuild: recompute causal event inputs from the masked raw sequence; never reuse events made from the unmasked target group
masking.target: standardized values of masked raw channels at the same row
masking.loss: mean per-row SmoothL1 across the selected masked group; each semantic group has equal per-row weight regardless of channel count
masking.causal_state: left-to-right GRU; state resets for each sequence and is detached at 2000-row TBPTT boundaries

model.pretrainer: plain RNNModel GRU, hidden 512, one layer, linear input projection, GELU readout
model.task_teacher: plain RNNModel GRU, hidden 512, one layer, linear input projection, two-output task head

transfer.initialize_task_readout: cold with identical seed in control and candidate

arms.name: cold_8_epoch_rowpass_matched
arms.role: primary two-extra-sequence-pass control; row-pass matched, not FLOP matched

supervised.checkpoint_selection: fixed final declared epoch; no evaluation during fitting

primary_endpoint.clipping: official evaluation clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weighting
primary_endpoint.primary_statistic: equal-fold mean of paired seed-average endpoint score differences
primary_endpoint.exposure: all four outer folds have prior exposure; robustness evidence only

seed_bootstrap.rule: renormalize over available seed cells within each fold; redraw if a fold receives zero weight

component_bootstrap.rule: paired component resampling within fold with shared multiplicities across arms and seeds

primary_endpoint.multiplicity: Holm over the three frozen pairwise arm contrasts
primary_endpoint.confidence_scope: separate conditional exposed-fold component and fitting-seed uncertainty; no pristine holdout or public transfer estimate

decision.interpretation: priority reference for teacher follow-up, not a universal stop threshold; uncertainty can justify a targeted descendant
decision.success: T1 shows useful paired task score versus compute-matched C1 with finite optimization and no material fold collapse
decision.uncertainty: zero-crossing intervals remain unresolved; inspect per-fold and per-seed consistency before allocating a student-transfer study
decision.negative_scope: this group mask, 32-row span, 512x1 GRU, two-epoch pretraining and the specified weight-transfer path only
decision.public_score_impact: unknown until a valid submission is evaluated

resources.profile_gate: actual B300, one GPU, strict FP32, pretraining 2-update real-data shape profile plus canonical trainer shape profile
resources.matrix_execution: up to eight independent cell workers, one B300 per fit, arms serialized within each cell, no DDP

artifacts.private_data: not copied into Git or archives
